lines.text: They say I'm young, don't understand,
But feelings run deep, across the land.
Judgments come, but I stand tall,
Ready to answer love's call.
Age is just a number, heart knows best,
Put me to the test.
Old enough to know what's real,
Old enough to feel the deal.
Not too young, hear my voice,
Old enough, my choice.
Lessons learned from every fall,
Rising up, breaking the wall.
Dreams are big, won't hold back,
On this track, no turning back.
Fire inside, burning bright,
Into the night.
Old enough to know what's real,
Old enough to feel the deal.
Not too young, hear my voice,
Old enough, my choice.
Doubts fade away, I believe,
Achieve what I conceive.
Old enough to know what's real,
Old enough to feel the deal.
Not too young, hear my voice,
Old enough, rejoice.
